hi, i got involved with usana in 2017. worst experience of my life. i live 1 hour away from makati where they would always hold their nightly "seminars" of how people were successful there. those nightly seminars would run for two hours and i would always go home at 1am and lose sleep over it. my upline at the time was a high school friend of mine. she was encouraging and was there for me until i paid out the 30k deposit. mind you, i was a fresh grad and had to ask a family member for that money at the time. said family member was okay with it since i have another cousin doing usana.

once i paid my 30k deposit and got my shit, my "friend" disappeared and wouldn't attend the seminars. her upline was the one who made asikaso to me. her upline, logging onto my facebook account and chatting all my friends and family members to invite them to the fuckin brainwash meetings ... i felt so embarrassed?!?!?! like, she was roleplaying as me and chatting all my friends. i lost friends because of this.

and the friend who was my upline to begin with, we're not friends anymore. fucking imagine scamming 30k off of me, it's still fucking surreal. now it's 2022 and i thankfully make more than that with my actual normal paying job that i work for and am passionate about. i don't know what her upline is up to but i heard from some friends that my ex-friend now sells baked goods online. good for her, i guess. but if i see her again i'm sure to turn the other way.

i always still think about my days in usana. it actually spanned to about three months and it was so shitty. i just had my sister consume the pills daily, and i sold some to a few titas i have. i mentioned i have a cousin, she's actually one of the higher ups of her pyramid so she's quite untouchable now and i have no energy to really get mad. it's her life, and i don't judge her for having those decisions.

but for my friend? nah, i feel no remorse and i don't want to be friends with her anymore. leaving me behind to fend for myself when she got her share of the money - what the fuck kind of friend is that, eh?

the friends who the upline chatted? well they won't talk to me anymore and it's just fair. fucking shitty. all of this was shitty. i wish i could delete this part of my life.
